chapter 4 of 5
Hidden triangles

The exam rarely hands you a labelled right-angled triangle. It hides one inside a rectangle, a ladder, or an isosceles triangle.

The first thing the examiner looks for is whether you found the right triangle at all. Sketch it separately if it helps; that is never penalised.
